name: codepen-commander
description: Sync local folders with CodePen 2.0 Pens via the CodePen API v2

scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then((fs) => { fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.rmSync('.test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); })"
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test .test-dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: if [ -z "$PUBLISH" ]; then echo '\n🛑 ERROR: This package must be published using `npm run pub`\n' && exit 1; fi
scripts.pub: PUBLISH=true npm run build && cd dist && npm publish
scripts.pub:dry-run: PUBLISH=true npm run build && cd dist && npm publish --dry-run
